title: Regiment and Uniform
author: Astrid Sandoval
blurb: Sable Nakamura, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
